metadata.ripgrep:
ripgrep 15.2.0 (rev e89fff89ac)

features:+pcre2
simd(compile):+NEON
simd(runtime):+NEON

PCRE2 10.45 is available (JIT is available)

storage: No persistent index or body cache. Before explicitly uses --no-cache, after never persists. Source hashes removed after; benchmark artifact hashes are recorded outside measured requests.
processCold: Every sample spawns a new process. No warm-up samples discarded. firstMs is the first observed invocation in this run, not a guarantee of cold executable pages.

diskCache.regime: OS page cache uncontrolled; source and executable pages may be warm. Fresh processes and no application caches only.
diskCache.reason: Unable to purge disk buffers: Operation not permitted

ordering: Rotate before/after/rg each repetition; no automatic retries; startup, traversal, extraction/ranking and serialization included.
limits: Single macOS machine, tiny synthetic documents. Not a universal performance claim.
BM25 and literal are different retrieval operations; the shared identifier only checks equivalent matches in this controlled workload.
Filename comparison uses rg --files without relevance ranking; one-file workload has a single candidate.
2000-file sample uses three repeats; p95 is the maximum and is unstable. Existing source corpus must be generated by benchmark-agent-search.mjs.
